name: Pathfinder bus
description: Flight computer, structure, and a 300 Wh battery. Required for every flight.

name: Pioneer engine
description: A light chemical engine. Good for Earth orbit and efficient small payloads.

name: Voyager engine
description: Higher specific impulse saves propellant on lunar transfers. Illustrative high-performance chemical propulsion.

name: Compact tank
description: 350 kg of propellant, plus 45 kg of tank structure.

name: Transfer tank
description: More delta-v, but a heavier and more expensive launch payload.

name: Expedition tank
description: 3200 kg for ambitious missions. Check the launch payload limit.

name: Solar wings
description: 260 W at Earth–Moon distance in full sunlight. Eclipses reduce output.

name: High-output array
description: 650 W gives scientific instruments a healthier power margin.

name: S-band antenna
description: Earth-local communications. Insufficient for the lunar missions in this game.

name: Deep-space dish
description: A directional link suitable for lunar distance. Higher power demand.

name: Survey camera
description: Lightweight imaging for atmospheric and Earth observations.

name: Spectral imager
description: Richer science requires more mass, power, and funding.

name: Landing assembly
description: Shock-absorbing legs and a radar altimeter. Required for a soft lunar landing.
